Refreshed enumeration reported the database window minimized; binding to window 12715224 surfaced the Access Database Backup As dialog.
ui_recovery_attempts.recovery: Canceled the backup dialog without saving. No new field attempt was counted, and no backup was saved.

note: Engine tests reset the test database from Clean_Baseline.accdb after each case. Visible UI cases cover tblPetParent and a partial tblAppointment subset; 32 fields remain without visible attempts, ZLS entry is not expressible for the documented text R2 cases, and visible T01-T22 replay was not run. This continuation attempted tblCashAccount but CUA could not capture the reopened database window (see ui_recovery_attempts). Test-only data is not for merge.
